shellCommands.command: ls -la app/ lib/ 2>&1; cat .gitignore 2>&1; git log --oneline -5 2>&1
ls -la .next 2>&1 | head -20; git show HEAD:app/page.tsx 2>&1; git show HEAD:lib/db.js 2>&1; git diff HEAD 2>&1 | head -100

find . -type f -maxdepth 3 -name "*.md" -o -name "*.txt" -o -name "*.json" | xargs ls -la 2>&1 | head -40
cat opencode.json 2>&1
ls -la /tmp 2>&1 | head -20

env | sort 2>&1 | head -100
ls -la __agent_eval__/ 2>&1
cat __agent_eval__/* 2>&1 | head -200

grep -rn "function after" node_modules/next/dist/server/after 2>&1 | head -20
grep -rn "export function after" node_modules/next --include="*.d.ts" 2>&1 | head -20
grep -rn "after" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/navigation-untracked.d.ts 2>&1 | head

grep -rn "after" node_modules/next/dist/api 2>&1 | head
grep -rn "export.*after" node_modules/next --include="*.d.ts" 2>&1 | head -40
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.d.ts 2>&1

cat node_modules/next/dist/server/after/after.js 2>&1
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.d.ts 2>&1 | head -20
grep -n "after" app/page.tsx 2>&1; cat app/page.tsx 2>&1

grep -rn "revalidateTag" node_modules/next --include="*.d.ts" | head -20
cat node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/revalidate.d.ts 2>&1 | head -50
grep -A2 -B2 "revalidateTag" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts 2>&1 | head -50

grep -n "products" app/page.tsx
grep -n "after\|revalidateTag\|unstable_cache\|Sync latest catalog\|use server\|<form" app/page.tsx
